title: Win Likelihood Simulator
lede: Explore how Jalen Brunson's expected scoring behaviour correlates with the Knicks' likelihood of securing a win.

sections.title: Forecast Logic
sections.body: This simulation evaluates Brunson's recent form over his last 10 games, adjusting for venue and opponent context. Adjust the hypothetical points total to see how historical team outcomes change based on his offensive output.

sections.title: Historical Win Likelihood by Point Band
sections.description: Visualise how team success scales with individual scoring milestones.

demoSteps: Review the predicted scoring band for the upcoming away fixture.
Interact with the win likelihood simulator by selecting different scoring bands (e.g., under 25, 25-29, 30+).
Observe the shift in the team's historical win likelihood as the expected point value changes.
Consult the 10-game recent form table to validate the transparency of the forecast baseline.
notes: The UI should include an interactive control (like a segmented toggle or slider) to let the user pick a 'What-If' points band, which dynamically updates the highlighted Win Likelihood.
Ensure all UI copy strictly follows UK spelling conventions (e.g., behaviour, colour, organise).
The 'Recent Form Baseline' table is populated with placeholder fixture data to demonstrate the 10-game window logic without requiring a live API.
